_README: Hand corrections applied after the extractor runs. Design doc step 6:
spot-check every tender by hand, about 3 minutes each.
drop: [key]            remove a row the extractor got wrong
set:  {key: {field:v}} patch fields on a row that is nearly right
add:  [requirement]    insert a clause read by a human
Every added row still needs a real source_quote and page -- the UI shows it.

iso_27001.source_quote: Als u niet minimaal 2 jaar ISO 27001 gecertificeerd bent, voldoet u niet aan deze geschiktheidseis.

648631-2026._why: p10 lists 'aanvullende certificeringen' as a scoring bonus, not a knock-out geschiktheidseis. Only the ISO 27001 clause on p24 is an eis.

638336-2026._why: The extractor now reads the real clause verbatim from p35. The hand-written add that used to live here was a paraphrase, which tools/verify_quotes.py correctly flagged as unciteable. Left empty on purpose as a worked example.
